label: More such carries distinct-cause transfer
meaning: A distinct cause of r in x is more r than x, and whatever is more r than something is r, so it is in act in r. This shows the cost of 'more such' at an arbitrary perfection: given that what is more such has the perfection (the quarta via's 'what is more such is such'), it entails distinct-cause transfer. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (omission models). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
